newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: 3 die in Colombia market shoot-out, corpses found.
newsitem.headline: 3 die in Colombia market shoot-out, corpses found.

text.p: Three people died in a shootout between leftist guerrillas and right-wing paramilitaries in a public market in northeast Colombia on Wednesday, police said.

The fight broke out in the mountain town of Ocana in Norte de Santander province. Police in the town were unable to say whether the dead were members of the paramilitary gang or National Liberation Army (ELN) rebels. Three passers-by were also injured.
"This seems to have been a fight between paramilitaries and guerrillas but witnesses have not told us much out of fear," a police spokesman said.
Gunmen of the left and right are battling for political and territorial control of much of the province.

In northwest Antioquia province, meanwhile, six corpses, with bullet wounds and torture marks, were found floating in a hydroelectric dam -- the apparent victims of a mass killing last week, police said.

None of the victims have so far been identified and the motive for the killings was not immediately clear. Two other corpses were found in the same dam near the town of Entrerios earlier this week, police sources said.
